svg.title: Paper Fig. 3: matched ten-seed reference by climatology-channel interaction
svg.desc: Two row-wise heatmaps of all-time and observed-hot interaction in kelvin for 10 paired seeds and four region-year cases. Negative interaction indicates reduced marginal benefit with a blended reference.
svg.text: Paper Fig. 3 · source-trained JAX CNN · 10 paired initializations × 4 target cases
I = [RMSE(B,S) − RMSE(B,H)] − [RMSE(P,S) − RMSE(P,H)] · Negative = less added channel value under blend.
Evidence: verified 160-report replay (Actions 42124190191); same seeds reused across cases. Exploratory, not independent climates.
